takeaways.headline: New AI models and tools spark trials while security policies force holds

items.title: Assess high‑impact AI models
items.meaning: DPA could evaluate Claude Fable 5.2, Gemini 4 Hydrogen, GPT‑6.2 Astra and Claude Code for document extraction, research and developer assistance.
items.use: Run synthetic PDF extraction, research prompts and code‑completion tests this week, comparing accuracy, speed and token cost against current baselines.

items.title: Trial tools for agentic pipelines
items.meaning: DPA could pilot MAI Code 2, Tool Retrieval and Gemini Decisions API to speed coding, manage large tool libraries and run fast bounded‑choice QA on synthetic filings.
items.use: Create a sandbox with dummy data pipelines, enable MAI Code 2 in Copilot, integrate Tool Retrieval into a Gemini agent and test the Decisions API on mock compliance checks.

items.title: Hold insecure packages and enforce compliance
items.meaning: DPA must pause Microsoft Agent Framework, Grok Build and the CERT‑In AI Security Auditing Guidelines, audit dependencies and lock down any agentic workflow until security reviews are complete.
items.use: Immediately freeze all builds that import the Microsoft Agent Framework, run a full dependency audit, and update internal policies to meet CERT‑In requirements before any future agent deployment.
